module.purpose: Provides the organization settings route layout and prevents users without an organization association from accessing nested pages.
module.summary: This asynchronous Next.js layout loads the authenticated server session using request headers and cookies, checks several supported organization fields on the user profile, redirects unaffiliated users to their personal profile settings, and otherwise renders the nested route content unchanged.
module.businessContext: This guards organization administration settings for users belonging to an organization. If it fails, unauthorized or unaffiliated users may access organization-specific settings.
functions: SettingsOrganizationsLayout (~L8-17): Authorizes organization settings access and renders nested route content

io: Reads request headers and cookies through Next.js server request APIs.
